title: Settlement Agreements: Expired Earlier Offers and the Three-Payment Call Window
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Lapsed-Offer Shortening of the Call Window

Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements records show every settlement offer on an account with its offer date and status, and an expired offer is one the consumer let lapse unaccepted.

**Rule.** When a consumer accepts a Three-Payment Settlement offer on a recorded call, where two or more settlement offers on the account dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date have expired unaccepted, the Three-Payment call window is shortened by 3 days for lapsed offers; where exactly one such offer has expired, by 1 day; an account with no such expired offer takes no lapsed-offer shortening.

| Expired offers on the account dated within the twelve-month span | Shortening |
|---|---|
| two or more | 3 days |
| exactly one | 1 day |
| none | none |

## Points of judgement

- **Which offers count?** Settlement offers on the same account, of any programme, whose offer date falls after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date and whose status is expired.
- **Do withdrawn or defaulted settlements count?** No; only offers that expired unaccepted.
- **Hypothetical dates.** For an acceptance on the 10th of a month, an expired offer dated the 10th of that month one year earlier is outside the span; one dated the 11th is inside it.
